about: docs/islands.md. `valid`: an island declaration and a view that use it, which must check. `refusals`: a declaration and a view (or a whole program) and the rule tag that refuses it. `{sha:path}` in a program is the SHA-256 of the corpus file `path`, and `{SHA:path}` is the same in upper case. Checked by crates/cancho-ui/tests/islands.rs.
decl: island Stones { script: "a.js" sha256: "{sha:a.js}"; label: "Stones"; width: 100; height: 50; props { seed: Int; pointer: Pointer; } events { Picked: Int; Closed; } }

valid.name: the base island, bound to a literal and heard
an island that is heard on both events
valid.view: Stones { seed: 1 on: Picked on: Closed }

valid.name: an island with no event heard
two islands of one name with different props
valid.view: Stones { seed: 1 } Stones { seed: 2 on: Picked }
